title: Concession Recapture on Lease-Break Requests — Lease Term Agreement Accounting Entry
content:
The unearned part of a move-in rent concession is recaptured on the Lease Term Agreement account when a lease-break request ends the new-lease term early. This entry sets out when the recapture is booked and the agent tool that books it.

## Rule

1. This rule sets the concession recapture booked on the term account for an open lease-break request made on a lease's new-lease term whose term program recaptures concessions.
2. It is booked against that request, once per request.
3. A concession is never recaptured once the new-lease term has run to its end date.
4. Exits by the Early Termination Option or under a later term are recaptured as the early termination rule states.

An open lease-break request is a lease-break request that stands in submitted status on the term. The new-lease term is the first term of the lease, the one that began at move-in; the programs that recapture concessions are those whose concession recapture setting shows Yes in the lease break liability settings.

| Request and term | Concession recapture under this rule |
|---|---|
| Open lease-break request on the new-lease term, program recaptures concessions | Booked against the request, once |
| Same, a recapture already booked against that request | Not booked again |
| Open lease-break request on a renewal or transfer term | Not under this rule |
| Early Termination Option request | Not under this rule |

## Tool — `book_concession_recapture_8b577669`

**Capability.** Books a concession recapture charge on a Lease Term Agreement account for one early exit request: the unearned part of the move-in concession that the resident owes back because the term ends early. One call adds one concession recapture charge line on the term account, tied to the request given and dated today, and raises the term's outstanding balance by the amount. Afterwards the term account shows the recapture line and the higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_concession_recapture_8b577669` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `term_id` | Reference number of the Lease Term Agreement the charge posts to, as returned by the lease term lookup | identifier |
| `request_id` | Reference number of the early termination or lease break request the charge arises from, as returned by the term change request lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | The recapture amount charged | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive figure already rounded to the cent; never empty |

**Return.** A receipt carrying `term_charge_id` (the reference number of the new charge line), `term_id`, `request_id`, `fee_code` (always `concession_recapture`), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `assessed_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the term balance after the charge, USD, 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying a `term_charge_id` means the charge was booked.
